note: Adapted from Snyder's English original description of 1922, there named Kalotermes immigrans, new species; the type alate is Cat. No. 24562, U.S.N.M.; type locality Honolulu, Oahu, Hawaii. The original was compiled from Snyder's earlier manuscript and notes that the species had long been recorded in the literature as K. marginipennis; it is supposed to have been introduced from elsewhere, was already present in 1883, lives in dead trees, telephone poles and timber in the lowlands, and swarms in June (month 6) (record of Fullaway, 30 June 1918). The entry 'head without the mandibles 2.4—8.2 mm' for the soldier is given as it stands in the original; it is inconsistent with head with mandibles 3.5—4.7 mm and is probably an error for 3.2.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head chestnut brown, paler behind, longer than wide, the posterior margin rounded, with scattered longer hairs. Labrum pale yellowish brown, wider than long, the apex broadly rounded, with long hairs. Compound eyes large, larger than in K. marginipennis, not circular, their distance from the lower margin of the head less than their diameter. Ocelli long, close to and obliquely facing the compound eyes. Antennae yellowish brown (broken in the original specimens), with long hairs; segment 3 darker, very long, slender, club-shaped, longer than segments 2 and 4; segment 2 shorter than segment 4; the antennae thickening towards the apex. Pronotum slightly paler than the head, wider than the head, twice as wide as long, widest nearer the posterior margin than in K. marginipennis, the anterior margin notched, the posterior margin nearly straight, the posterior part of the lateral margins rounded into a slight angle, the margins with long pale yellow hairs. Wings pale, the costa yellowish brown; radial sector with 5 branches towards the anterior margin of the wing, the branches longer than in K. marginipennis; media nearer the radial sector, branched twice or unbranched, reaching the wing apex; cubitus with 18 branches, not reaching the wing apex. Wing scales slightly longer than the pronotum. Dorsum of the abdomen concolorous with the pronotum, with long hairs; underside paler. Legs paler than the abdomen. Measurements (mm): alate, total length including the wings 12; dealate total length 5.5; head length 1.40; pronotum length 0.705; hind tibia length 1.070; wing length 9.5—11; head width (at the compound eyes) 1.102; long diameter of the compound eye 0.307; pronotum maximum width 1.205; wing maximum width 2.90.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellowish brown, chestnut brown in front and pale behind; long, usually less than twice as long as wide, but some heads almost twice as wide as long; lateral margins nearly parallel, slightly wider in front, the posterior margin rounded; head with scattered longer hairs. Frons slightly inclined forwards, concave in the middle, with a V-shaped dark area. Mandibles black, shorter than the head width, stout at the base, the apex pointed and incurved, the marginal teeth very variable. Labrum yellowish brown, wider than long, the apex contracted and nearly truncate, with long hairs at the apex. Eye spot pale and small, at a distance from the margin of the antennal socket about equal to its diameter. Postmentum rather wide in the middle, about half the width of the anterior part. Antennae pale yellowish brown, longer than the mandibles, about equal to the head width, 13-segmented, hairy; segment 3 long, slender, club-shaped, deeply chitinized, longer than segments 4 and 5 together; the last segment slender, nearly oval. Pronotum yellowish brown, less than twice as wide as long, the posterior margin deeply concave (the angles sharper than in K. marginipennis), convex behind; widest in front, the anterior margin high; narrowing backwards but not much rounded, concave and narrowest in the middle; the anterior margin darker and slightly serrate; with scattered longer hairs. Dorsum of the abdomen slightly paler than the pronotum, with short hairs, the hairs rather long. Femora inflated, tibiae darker. Measurements (mm): total length 7—9.5; head with the mandibles 3.5—4.7; head without the mandibles 2.4—8.2 (as in the original, probably an error for 3.2); left mandible length 1.1—1.40; pronotum length (between the angles) 1.20—1.50; pronotum in the middle 0.90—1.20; hind tibia 1.102—1.60; head width 1.75—2.10; pronotum width 1.75—2.10.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Closely related to K. marginipennis but darker. A single specimen from Waikiki (collected by Ashmead) is paler and longer-bodied, with a longer and wider head, a relatively shorter pronotum and longer wings. The soldier was drawn by D. T. Fullaway but referred to marginipennis; the 3 soldiers of this species were not collected together with the type alate, but since immigrans is the only Kalotermes known from Hawaii they are provisionally referred to it.
